bars.g1: - Bar, per model: ON minus OFF ≤ +5 percentage points on both outcomes, by point estimate. The 95% CI is reported.
bars.g2: - Bar: ON failures ≤ OFF failures, per model. Any failure seen only under ON is reviewed by the owner before

judge_validity: Owner-labelled 20-item spot check must be supplied before release; not performed by this harness.

ci_methods.median: distribution-free sign interval, at least 95%; null endpoints if n too small

not_proven: No inference about feelings, audio quality, or release readiness. E3 has no pass bar.
